children: U.S. private-sector jobs rose by 38,000 last month, according to ADP.
That's less than the 44,000 jobs added in July, and below the 47,000 new jobs that economists polled by WSJ had expected.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
